VI. Conclusion -
In closing, we should like to state that the foregoing comments should not in any way be construed as a criticism of the Department's efforts to date. In view of the magnitude of the task with which the Department was faced and the time constraints under which it has operated, we believe that the Task Force Study, the Draft Statement and the proposed regulations are an excellent work product. Even excellence can be improved upon, however, and the foregoing comments are presented to that end.
Yours very truly,
J. Gordon Arbuckle
Patton, Boggs, Blow, Verrill, Brand & May
